statement: ∀ (theta : (ℚ ⊗[R p] Ji p M y v 0) →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ), (∀ (q : ℚ) (c : Ji p M y v 0), theta (TensorProduct.tmul (R p) q c) = (q : ℂ) * (c : ℂ)) → Function.Injective theta → Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] Ji p M y v 0) = 1 → ∀ a : ℂ, a ∈ Ji p M y v 0 → a ≠ 0 → ∀ c : ℂ, c ∈ Ji p M y v 0 → ∃! q : ℚ, c = (q : ℂ) * a
proof:
intro theta ht hinj hd a ha ha0 c hc
let A : ℚ ⊗[R p] Ji p M y v 0 := TensorProduct.tmul (R p) (1 : ℚ) ⟨a, ha⟩
let C : ℚ ⊗[R p] Ji p M y v 0 := TensorProduct.tmul (R p) (1 : ℚ) ⟨c, hc⟩
have hA : theta A = a := by simp [A, ht]
have hC : theta C = c := by simp [C, ht]
have hA0 : A ≠ 0 := by
  intro hz
  apply ha0
  rw [← hA, hz, map_zero]
have hs (q : ℚ) : theta (q • A) = (q : ℂ) * a := by
  rw [map_smul, hA]
  simp [Algebra.smul_def]
obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' A hA0).mp hd C
have hqc : c = (q : ℂ) * a := by rw [← hC, ← hq, hs]
refine ⟨q, hqc, ?_⟩
intro r hr
have heq : r • A = q • A := hinj (by rw [hs, hs, ← hr, ← hqc])
exact smul_left_injective ℚ hA0 heq
